## The two-agent method in one paragraph

Every inventory or extraction is made twice, by Claude and by Codex, each from the same evidence (the PDF, the page map, the agreed indexes) and without seeing the other's output. A script compares the two mechanically; cells that match are `agreed`; cells that differ are settled by a documented rule, a convention, or a re-read of the page, and the resolution is written down with credit to whichever reading was right. Agreement between two agents is not confirmation: a student reviews every disagreement and audits a 5 to 10 percent sample of agreements, and only recorded audits count (`qa/audits.csv`).
